# f5xc_known_label (Resource)

Get Label Request Get Label Request is used in following way namespace = shared if query = QUERY_ALL_LABELS than key and value are ignored and complete list of labels from current tenants shared namespace and ves-io/shared namespace are returned if query = QUERY_EXACT_LABELS than label matching exact key and value are returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io/shared namespace if query = QUERY_VALUE_PREFIX_LABELS than labels matching key=value are returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io shared namespace are returned if query = QUERY_KEY_PREFIX_LABELS than value is ignored and  labels matching key are returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io shared namespace are returned

To get more information about f5xc_known_label, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/known-label)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Known Label - Basic

resource "f5xc_known_label_key" "key" {
  key       = "example-kl"
  namespace = "shared"
}

resource "f5xc_known_label" "example" {
  key       = "example-kl"
  value     = "example-val"
  namespace = "shared"

  depends_on = [f5xc_known_label_key.key]
}
```

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_known_label.example <namespace>/<key>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl

	id = "<namespace>/<key>"
	to = "f5xc_known_label.example"
}
```
